title: tracker criterion accept --json
description: Records every criterion's text in written, from an interactive terminal only (DESIGN.md §2.1, §2.7). Without one, it exits 1 with the error shape.

accepted.description: true when written changed, with a criterion-accept entry added to history. false when written already matched the criteria, so nothing changed and no question was asked.

item.description: The item afterwards, exactly as its file holds it.
